title: Understanding Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
text: Bootstrap confidence intervals are constructed using the percentiles of the bootstrap distribution. In this case, the $$2.5th$$ and $$97.5th$$ percentiles are given. Think about how these percentiles relate to the confidence interval.

title: Percentiles and Confidence Intervals
text: The $$2.5th$$ and $$97.5th$$ percentiles of the bootstrap distribution represent the lower and upper bounds of the 95% confidence interval. Consider how these values can be used to form the interval for the population mean.
